_fixture: A COMMITTED, INSIDE-EVERY-BOUND lane-status document. It is the baseline that test/config/lane-status-bounds.test.ts mutates into tmpdir copies to prove each size bound red-first. It is never mutated in place, so a mutation that failed to apply cannot be mistaken for a restored baseline: both would print ok, and only one of them is this file. The live docs/lane-status.json is gitignored and has no committed baseline, which is why the proof runs here instead.
focus: Fixture lane, standing still on purpose so a gate can be proven against it.
nextBoundary: Nothing is in flight; this document exists to be measured.

queue.title: The row that is doing something, so the exactly-one-next rule has a predecessor to sit behind.
The one startable next row, with no blocker named, so the baseline is green on every pre-existing check as well as on the three bounds.
An open row, so the queue is not a two-row degenerate case.
A blocked row that names its blocker, because blocked with no blocker named is its own defect.
